ton_iot.access_method: Manual download from the UNSW SharePoint link on the official page
ton_iot.selected_scope: TON-IoT train/test network subset only (train_test_network.csv), with the official Network Features-Description and Statistics documents; exclude Processed_Network_dataset, SecurityEvents_Network_datasets ground-truth files, raw network logs, operating-system datasets, and sensor telemetry datasets.
ton_iot.license_note: UNSW states free use for academic research in perpetuity and requires citation of the dataset papers

ciciot2023.access_method: Complete the CIC download form linked from the official UNB page, then download the CSV directory
ciciot2023.selected_scope: Official CICIoT2023 CSV/CSV.zip standard per-category directory release; labels are derived deterministically from directory and filename; exclude MERGED_CSV.zip, PCAP, example, and Supplementary Materials.
ciciot2023.license_note: Use is subject to the terms displayed by CIC/UNB at download time; retain a dated copy of those terms

n_baiot.access_method: Download the 1.7 GB archive from the UCI dataset page
n_baiot.selected_scope: All nine device directories and their benign, Mirai, and BASHLITE traffic files
n_baiot.license_note: CC BY 4.0 as stated by the UCI Machine Learning Repository
